about: Owning cases of the two-stage move of the account pools and the gateway token out of the global JSON. A case lays files out as the machine-files fixture does (files, raw, dirs, links, modes; plus before: step index to extra files laid before that step) and runs steps in order: plan, copy, finish (checked: false withholds the machine check), snapshot. A step may set confined, abortAt (the observer returns an error at that Step), editAt with append (the observer appends text to the global file at that Step), holdLock with waitMs (a child process holds global-config). Only the last step's result is compared with expect; earlier steps must succeed (or abort where abortAt says so). Expect: code with file, path and reason; io (an observer abort); paths; reformatted; plan [path, entries, state]; snapshot with at and notices [id, path]; and the state of the files: global (exact lines), globalUnchanged, globalAppended, accounts (parsed), accountsText, accountsAbsent, accountsStable, token, tokenAbsent, modes (relative to the global directory), backups (count), backupName, backupEqualsOriginal, backupMode, backupDirMode. sentinels never appear in any shown form of a refusal.

gateway: token: {type: string, x-fgos-file: token, x-fgos-sensitivity: secret-value, x-fgos-scope: global-only}
